description: Local-first, AI-assisted creative writing. Bring your own model - cloud or local.
description_good_justification: https://github.com/jmerifjKriwe/narrare#readme describes what it is and who it is for
discussion_justification: https://github.com/jmerifjKriwe/narrare/issues - public, searchable, URL-addressable, no proprietary client

dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: pytest assertions and the fuzz target's contract assertions

name: Narrare
